Nice dinner in Sa Pa
Aug 2024 • Friends
It's the hotel restaurant. Slightly out of the chaos of downtown. Large and bright dining room. The order girl speaks good English, a fact to be reckoned with in this area.
Good spring rolls both vegetarian and salmon although a little greasy. 
I took the chicken fried noodles very good, the other diners also enjoyed their dishes especially my vegetarian daughter. 
The only drawback is pizza: they look like the classic pizzas that you could eat in France a bit soft, sweetish and of course with a cheese that is not mozzarella.
Excellent value for money.

A culinary oasis in the heart of Sapa
Sep 2023 • Couples
Its atmosphere is welcoming and informal, perfect for those who want to enjoy a delicious dinner without too much formality. Halosa's menu is a feast for vegetarian palates, with a wide selection of dishes that mix local and international flavours. From vegetable curry to sautéed tofu, each dish is prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients, making every bite an explosion of flavour. Its setting is enchanting, with a large terrace overlooking the surrounding mountains, offering a view breathtaking during the day and creating a romantic atmosphere for an elegant evening dinner.

Enjoy a stylish and local atmosphere!
Aug 2023 • Couples
The reasonably priced dishes are all fresh and delicious, made with local ingredients. The stylish interior is a fusion of traditional Vietnamese decor and modern elements, making it extremely comfortable.
The friendly atmosphere, where locals gather, is one of the attractions. You're sure to enjoy interacting with the locals. We especially recommend the salad made with fresh locally grown vegetables and the traditional Vietnamese dish platter. With a wide variety of menu items to choose from, you'll definitely have a hard time deciding what to eat.
You can also enjoy local alcohol at Harosa Restaurant. They also have a selection of beers unique to Vietnam, as well as coffee, which makes a great souvenir.

The fried rice and black chicken hot pot combo at Halosa Restaurant
Jun 2023 • Couples
A truly unique and delicious dining experience in Sapa, Vietnam. From the moment you step inside, the homey atmosphere and friendly staff make you feel right at home. The menu is full of amazing options, but my favorite is the Fried Rice and Black Chicken Hot Pot combo. The fried rice is cooked to perfection and the Black Chicken Hot Pot is full of flavor. And don't forget the spring rolls with meat - they are definitely worth trying!
